parts.text: When a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move:
That unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT] until the end of the turn.
That move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Dakkastorm
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

stratagems.name: Speediest Freeks
stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SPEED FREEKS unit.
stratagems.effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit fail on an unmodified hit roll of 1-3.

stratagems.name: Delicious Eating Squigs
stratagems.effect: Select any number of friendly ORKS INFANTRY units within 3" of your unit. Each selected unit heals 3 wounds.
